title: Chipotle Chicken Caesar Salad with Avocado and Lime
changes_from_base: Smoky chipotle and lime go into the dressing, and the salad becomes a main course with seared chicken breast and avocado.
summary: A hearty main-course Caesar with seared chicken breast, avocado and garlicky croutons, all tossed in a smoky chipotle and lime dressing.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
chipotle chilli in adobo, finely chopped

steps.title: Make the croutons
steps.text: Toss the bread with 2 tbsp oil and the garlic and fry in the pan over medium heat for 5 min, stirring, until golden. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp oil in the pan over medium-high heat and cook 5-6 min per side until golden and 74 °C in the centre. Rest 5 min, then slice.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, Parmesan, anchovies, chipotle, lime juice and garlic until smooth.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Toss the romaine and croutons with the dressing, pile onto plates, then top with sliced chicken and avocado.

tips: Adjust the chipotle to taste; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
Rest the chicken before slicing so it stays juicy.
Add the avocado last so it does not bruise.
storage: Best on the day. Keep leftover chicken and dressing separately in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
